title: CSS Radio Styler
description: Design custom radio buttons — colors, size, dot style — with a working live preview and CSS.
howto: Pick the accent color and radio size.
Choose the inner dot style (filled dot or ring).
Copy the code or download the self-contained radio.html.

faqs.q: How does the custom radio work?
faqs.a: The native input stays functional but hidden; a styled span draws the circle and the :checked selector reveals the inner dot.
Yes — real radio inputs with labels, so keyboard navigation and screen readers work, including arrow-key group behavior.
Give all inputs in a group the same name attribute — the sample markup shows how.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with rd- to avoid collisions.
